* Configuration object for * {@link WebViewCompat#startUpWebView(android.content.Context, WebViewStartUpConfig, WebViewCompat.WebViewStartUpCallback)}. *

* This is different from {@link ProcessGlobalConfig}. This object defines the configuration for * a particular call to * {@link WebViewCompat#startUpWebView(android.content.Context, WebViewStartUpConfig, WebViewCompat.WebViewStartUpCallback)}.

methods.name: public boolean shouldRunUiThreadStartUpTasks()
methods.comment:
* Whether to run only parts of startup that doesn't block the UI thread. *

* WebView startup tasks that are required to run on the UI thread are not attempted when * {@link WebViewCompat#startUpWebView(android.content.Context, WebViewStartUpConfig, WebViewCompat.WebViewStartUpCallback)} * is called if set to {@code false}. *

* Defaults to `true`. If not set to `false`, UI thread startup tasks will be * run.
